source_notes: Coverage is classification-driven: each 2025 Grand Prix or Sprint entry in historical_2025.json with Retired, Disqualified, or Did not start status is represented here.
Jolpica classification records establish final status only. Where no primary report establishes cause, fault, damaged components, or a repair amount, this file says so rather than inferring one.
Detailed records link to Formula1.com reporting. Team invoices and FIA cost-cap filings are not public; any non-zero range is a public component-cost proxy, never an actual team cost or FIA finding.
Public estimate reference: https://f1.top-app.eu/destructors-championship. CAD ranges are only supplied after physical damage is publicly described.

incidents.title: Jack Doohan — first-lap barrier impact
incidents.reason: Doohan crashed on the first racing lap at Turn 6 in wet conditions after the rear tyres appeared to spin up on a gear shift.

incidents.title: Fernando Alonso — Turn 6/7 barrier impact
incidents.reason: Alonso lost traction near the Turn 6 kerb, spun and made heavy contact with the wall before retiring.

incidents.title: Isack Hadjar — formation-lap barrier impact
incidents.reason: Hadjar spun into the barriers at Turn 2 in wet conditions on the formation lap. Formula 1 reported significant rear-wing damage and the start was delayed.

incidents.title: Gabriel Bortoleto — Sprint barrier impact
incidents.reason: Bortoleto hit the inside wall at Turn 1 while trying to escape Albon’s slipstream, then crossed the track into the barriers. The reported impact was 57g.

incidents.title: Lewis Hamilton — first-lap collision damage and retirement
incidents.reason: Hamilton sustained floor and front-wing damage in opening-lap incidents, then retired after the damage proved unmanageable. Formula 1 reported a five-second penalty for causing a collision.
incidents.responsible: Lewis Hamilton (five-second penalty for causing collision)

incidents.title: Charles Leclerc — collateral collision damage and retirement
incidents.reason: After Piastri hit Antonelli at the restart, the Mercedes struck Leclerc. The Ferrari suffered a puncture and front-suspension damage, forcing retirement.
incidents.estimate_label: Public component-cost proxy; not a team invoice

incidents.title: Gabriel Bortoleto — first-lap barrier impact after Stroll contact
incidents.reason: Bortoleto hit the barriers on the opening lap after contact with Lance Stroll and retired. The official report describes a Safety Car for recovery.

incidents.title: Lance Stroll — Turn 1 collision retirement
incidents.reason: Stroll was hit in the Turn 1 collision with Bortoleto and retired immediately. Aston Martin reported significant damage.
incidents.responsible: Gabriel Bortoleto (five-place grid penalty for causing collision)

incidents.title: Gabriel Bortoleto — Turn 1 collision with Lance Stroll

incidents.title: Alex Albon — Hamilton contact, front-wing replacement and retirement
incidents.reason: Albon collided with Hamilton, took a new front wing and later retired with damage. The official report also notes a five-second collision penalty.
